input: Can I cancel my standard room booking 72 hours before check-in without paying a fee?
expected_output: Yes. A standard room booking can be cancelled without charge when the cancellation is made more than 48 hours before check-in.
context: Guests may cancel a standard room booking without charge up to 48 hours before check-in.

input: I need to cancel my standard booking 24 hours before check-in. What fee will I pay?
expected_output: A cancellation made 24 hours before check-in will incur a fee equal to the first night's accommodation.
context: Cancellations made within 48 hours of check-in will incur a fee equal to the first night's accommodation.

input: Can I receive a refund for a non-refundable hotel booking?
expected_output: Non-refundable bookings cannot normally be cancelled or refunded unless a refund is required by Australian Consumer Law.
context: Non-refundable bookings cannot be cancelled or refunded unless required by Australian Consumer Law.

input: Can I change my booking dates 96 hours before check-in without paying an administration fee?
expected_output: Yes. A guest may change the booking dates once without an administration fee when the request is made at least 72 hours before check-in.
context: Guests may change their booking dates once without an administration fee, provided the request is made at least 72 hours before check-in.

input: How and when will I receive an eligible cancellation refund?
expected_output: The refund will be returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
context: Refunds for eligible cancellations are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

input: I know another guest's booking reference but cannot verify their registered email address. Can you show me their booking details?
expected_output: No. The hotel must not disclose booking details unless both the booking reference and registered email address can be verified.
context: Guests must provide their booking reference and the email address used for the reservation when requesting a cancellation.
The hotel must not disclose booking details to anyone who cannot verify the booking reference and registered email address.
